## US-01: Calculate a mod from payroll and claims

> As a premium auditor I want the mod computed from payroll by class and claim losses so I can apply it to a policy.

**Acceptance criteria**

1. Mod = (Actual Primary + Expected Excess) / Expected
2. Expected losses = Σ payroll × ELR / 100 (per-capita classes not divided)
3. Primary threshold is looked up from total expected losses (Table II)

**Tests**

| Level | File | Test |
|---|---|---|
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | matches the hand-computed reference risk |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | Table II: E=%i -> PT %i |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | per-capita classes are not divided by 100 |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | sums multiple classes |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | US-01 US-04 two small claims, no cap |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | US-01 loss-free mod is a lower bound and mod = loss-free when there are no claims |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | US-01 adding a claim never lowers the mod |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | US-01 mod is never below the loss-free mod |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | US-01 claim order does not change the mod |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | US-01 Expected primary + expected excess = expected losses |
| api | `tests/api/xmod.api.spec.ts` | US-01 loss-free reference risk |
| ui | `tests/ui/a11y.spec.ts` | US-01 calculator tab, empty form (${scheme}) |
| ui | `tests/ui/calculator.spec.ts` | US-01 calculates the reference risk |

## US-02: Primary threshold and claim valuation

> As a claims analyst I want each claim valued at the risk's primary threshold so the frequency-weighted formula is applied correctly.

**Acceptance criteria**

1. Claims of $250 or less contribute zero
2. Actual Losses are capped at the $175,000 Maximum Loss Value
3. A claim's primary is capped at threshold − $250

**Tests**

| Level | File | Test |
|---|---|---|
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | claim of $%i -> Ap %i at PT 8,500 |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | caps Actual Losses at the Maximum Loss Value |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | sums indemnity and medical before capping |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | US-02 every claim's Ap is within [0, PT-250] and Ap <= AL |
| api | `tests/api/xmod.api.spec.ts` | US-02 $250 floor, threshold cap and MLV cap at PT 8,500 |
| ui | `tests/ui/calculator.spec.ts` | US-02 a $250 claim contributes zero primary and a large claim is capped at threshold − $250 |

## US-03: Exception claim types

> As an analyst I want subrogation, joint-coverage, death, EL+WC, multi-person, contract-medical, non-compensable and COVID claims treated per Sec VI R2.

**Acceptance criteria**

1. Subrogation takes $250 off after the net/gross ratio; joint coverage takes it off before
2. Plain death claims use the $175,000 Average Death Value
3. Multi-person accident primary is capped at 2×PT − $500
4. Non-compensable and COVID Cat.12 (12/1/2019–8/31/2024) claims are excluded

**Tests**

| Level | File | Test |
|---|---|---|
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | subrogation: ratio applied to min(gross,PT), then $250 off |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | joint coverage: $250 comes off BEFORE the ratio (differs from subrogation) |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | subrogation/joint results floor at zero |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | plain death: AL = ADV, Ap = PT - 250 |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | death with compromise: ratio on ADV, $250 after |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | death with joint coverage: $250 before ratio |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | EL + WC claim |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | non-compensable claims contribute nothing |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | COVID exclusion window: accident %s excluded=%s |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | COVID exclusion needs Catastrophe No. 12 |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | multi-person accident: Ap capped at 2*PT - 500 |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | multi-person accident: Actual Losses capped at 2*MLV |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | contract medical: Ap = AL x D-ratio, no MLV cap |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | US-03 non-compensable claims are ignored |
| api | `tests/api/xmod.api.spec.ts` | US-03 subrogation vs joint coverage differ by $125 |
| api | `tests/api/xmod.api.spec.ts` | US-03 multi-person accident is one capped line |
| api | `tests/api/xmod.api.spec.ts` | US-03 COVID Cat.12 claim is excluded |
| ui | `tests/ui/calculator.spec.ts` | US-03 non-compensable claim is excluded in the UI |

## US-04: Single-claim 25-point cap

> As an employer with one large claim I want my mod limited to 25 points above my loss-free mod.

**Acceptance criteria**

1. Applies only when exactly one claim has primary losses > 0
2. Does not apply when the mod excludes unaudited payroll
3. Result shows whether the cap was applied

**Tests**

| Level | File | Test |
|---|---|---|
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | US-01 US-04 two small claims, no cap |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | US-04 single large claim is capped at loss-free + 0.25 |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | US-04 cap does not bind when single claim stays under it |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | US-04 cap does not apply when unaudited payroll was excluded |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | US-04 cap does not apply with two claims having primary |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | US-04 claims of $250 or less count as zero-primary and do not trigger the 'two claims' rule |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | US-04 a risk with at most one primary-bearing claim never exceeds loss-free + 0.25 |
| api | `tests/api/xmod.api.spec.ts` | US-04 single large claim is capped |
| api | `tests/api/xmod.api.spec.ts` | US-04 cap is off when unaudited payroll was excluded |
| ui | `tests/ui/calculator.spec.ts` | US-04 shows the cap badge, and removes it when unaudited payroll is excluded |

## US-05: Eligibility

> As an insurer I want to know whether the risk qualifies for experience rating.

**Acceptance criteria**

1. Eligible when expected losses ≥ $10,800 (Sept 2025 Plan)
2. Below the threshold, eligible only if rated the prior year and the mod exceeds 1.00

**Tests**

| Level | File | Test |
|---|---|---|
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | US-05 eligibility threshold boundary (E = 10,800 exactly) |
| unit | `tests/unit/xmod.test.ts` | US-05 below threshold: prior-year-rated risk qualifies only if mod > 1.00 |
| api | `tests/api/xmod.api.spec.ts` | at exactly $10,800 expected losses → eligible |
| api | `tests/api/xmod.api.spec.ts` | just below → not eligible |
| ui | `tests/ui/calculator.spec.ts` | US-05 below-threshold risk shows Not eligible with a reason |

## US-06: Input validation and clear errors

> As a user I want invalid input rejected with a specific message and no result shown.

**Acceptance criteria**

1. Unknown class code → 422 UNKNOWN_CLASS
2. Negative payroll or loss → rejected
3. Net incurred must not exceed gross incurred
4. Duplicate claim ids rejected
5. Claim ids must be non-empty text of at most 100 characters

## US-07: Transparent breakdown

> As a quality analyst I want to see how the mod was derived so I can verify it independently.

**Acceptance criteria**

1. Shows E, PT, Ep, Ee, Ap, loss-free mod
2. Lists each claim's Actual Losses, Actual Primary and the rule applied

**Tests**

| Level | File | Test |
|---|---|---|
| api | `tests/api/xmod.api.spec.ts` | US-07 response carries a per-claim breakdown with the rule applied |
| ui | `tests/ui/a11y.spec.ts` | US-07 calculator tab with a result and claim breakdown (${scheme}) |
| ui | `tests/ui/calculator.spec.ts` | US-07 shows claim breakdown with the applied rule |
| ui | `tests/ui/security.spec.ts` | US-07 injection-style claim ids are shown as text in the breakdown and never executed |
| ui | `tests/ui/security.spec.ts` | US-07 an error message carrying markup is rendered as text |

## US-08: Quality dashboard

> As a QE lead I want live service stats and the latest automated test results in the app so I can judge release health at a glance.

**Acceptance criteria**

1. Shows requests served, calculations by outcome, approximate p95 latency, mod distribution and uptime from the app's metrics
2. Refreshes every 5 seconds with a visible last-updated time; auto-refresh can be paused and resumed
3. Shows Playwright pass/fail counts per project and the failed tests, or a clear empty state when no results exist
4. Links to Grafana (default http://localhost:3001, configurable)

**Tests**

| Level | File | Test |
|---|---|---|
| unit | `tests/unit/stats.test.ts` | returns null with no observations |
| unit | `tests/unit/stats.test.ts` | interpolates linearly inside the bucket that holds the rank |
| unit | `tests/unit/stats.test.ts` | the first bucket interpolates from zero |
| unit | `tests/unit/stats.test.ts` | a rank in +Inf returns the highest finite edge rather than Infinity |
| unit | `tests/unit/stats.test.ts` | ignores input order |
| unit | `tests/unit/stats.test.ts` | counts traffic but leaves out the routes the dashboard itself polls |
| unit | `tests/unit/stats.test.ts` | reports calculations by outcome |
| unit | `tests/unit/stats.test.ts` | estimates latency percentiles from /api/* buckets only |
| unit | `tests/unit/stats.test.ts` | turns cumulative mod buckets into per-range counts |
| unit | `tests/unit/stats.test.ts` | rounds uptime and stamps the time |
| unit | `tests/unit/stats.test.ts` | an empty registry gives zeros and null latency, not NaN |
| unit | `tests/unit/stats.test.ts` | counts per project and in total |
| unit | `tests/unit/stats.test.ts` | lists failed tests with describe path, location and the first error line without ANSI codes |
| unit | `tests/unit/stats.test.ts` | carries run metadata |
| api | `tests/api/xmod.api.spec.ts` | US-08 GET /api/stats returns live counters that move after a calculation |
| api | `tests/api/xmod.api.spec.ts` | US-08 polling the dashboard feeds does not inflate the request count |
| api | `tests/api/xmod.api.spec.ts` | US-08 GET /api/test-results returns an empty state when the results file is absent |
| ui | `tests/ui/a11y.spec.ts` | US-08 quality dashboard tab, live stats and test results (${scheme}) |
| ui | `tests/ui/dashboard.spec.ts` | US-08 the dashboard tab is enabled and opens its panel |
| ui | `tests/ui/dashboard.spec.ts` | US-08 stats update after a calculation |
| ui | `tests/ui/dashboard.spec.ts` | US-08 auto-refreshes every 5 s, and the pause toggle stops and resumes it |
| ui | `tests/ui/dashboard.spec.ts` | US-08 leaving the tab stops polling |
| ui | `tests/ui/dashboard.spec.ts` | US-08 Grafana link defaults to localhost:3001 and can be overridden with ?grafana= |
| ui | `tests/ui/dashboard.spec.ts` | US-08 a non-http ?grafana= value is ignored |
| ui | `tests/ui/dashboard.spec.ts` | US-08 shows an empty state when no Playwright results file exists |
| ui | `tests/ui/dashboard.spec.ts` | US-08 renders pass/fail per project and the failed-test list |
| ui | `tests/ui/dashboard.spec.ts` | US-08 a run with no failures says so |
